title: 🆕 New Pair: 0xb5fbd336c968d0cb80... on robinhood
summary:
Thaler is a reserve-backed staking protocol launched through pons_v2 on Robinhood Chain in partnership with @ponsdotfamily. The name is the silver coin the word dollar descends from, and that is the whole idea: something with weight behind it rather than a claim on a spreadsheet.

The mechanism is deliberately simple. Every trade of THALER pays a fee. Those fees accrue into one public reserve that anyone can read on chain. Holders who stake their THALER are paid from that reserve, and only from that reserve. If the reserve has not earned it, nobody is paid it.

This is staking, not a rebase. No balance is multiplied, no supply is expanded, and nothing is minted to fund distributions. A protocol that mints what it hands out is moving value from holders to stakers and calling the result yield. Thaler spends what actually came in, which is a slower story and a truer one.

The reserve is not a figure the team reports. It is a balance you read. When there is nothing in it yet, the site says so instead of showing a number that means nothing. For the same reason Thaler publishes no APY, no runway, no coverage ratio and no holder count until there is a real balance to compute them from.

What is live today: the site and the console are deployed and read the chain. The token contract and reserve are the next phase.
